an4.178:1.1: “Monks, these four types of individuals are to be found existing in the world.
an4.178:1.3: “There is the case where a monk enters & remains in a certain peaceful awareness-release.
an4.178:1.4: He attends to the cessation of self-identification,
an4.178:1.5: but as he is attending to the cessation of self-identification his mind doesn’t leap up, grow confident, steadfast, or firm in the cessation of self-identification.
an4.178:1.6: For him the cessation of self-identification is not to be expected.
an4.178:1.7: Just as if a man were to grasp a branch with his hand smeared with resin, his hand would stick to it, grip it, adhere to it;
an4.178:1.8: in the same way, the monk enters & remains in a certain peaceful awareness-release.
an4.178:1.9: He attends to the cessation of self-identification,
an4.178:1.10: but as he is attending to the cessation of self-identification his mind doesn’t leap up, grow confident, steadfast, or firm in the cessation of self-identification.
an4.178:1.11: For him the cessation of self-identification is not to be expected.
an4.178:2.1: “Now, there is the case where a monk enters & remains in a certain peaceful awareness-release.
an4.178:2.2: He attends to the cessation of self-identification,
an4.178:2.3: and as he is attending to the cessation of self-identification his mind leaps up, grows confident, steadfast, & firm in the cessation of self-identification.
an4.178:2.4: For him the cessation of self-identification is to be expected.
an4.178:2.5: Just as if a man were to grasp a branch with a clean hand, his hand would not stick to it, grip it, or adhere to it;
an4.178:2.6: in the same way, the monk enters & remains in a certain peaceful awareness-release.
an4.178:2.7: He attends to the cessation of self-identification,
an4.178:2.8: and as he is attending to the cessation of self-identification his mind leaps up, grows confident, steadfast, & firm in the cessation of self-identification.
an4.178:2.9: For him the cessation of self-identification is to be expected.
an4.178:3.1: “Now, there is the case where a monk enters & remains in a certain peaceful awareness-release.
an4.178:3.2: He attends to the breaching of ignorance,
an4.178:3.3: but as he is attending to the breaching of ignorance his mind doesn’t leap up, grow confident, steadfast, or firm in the breaching of ignorance.
an4.178:3.4: For him the breaching of ignorance is not to be expected.
an4.178:3.5: Just as if there were a waste-water pool that had stood for countless years,
an4.178:3.6: where a man were to block all the inlets and open all the outlets, and the sky were to not rain down in good streams of rain:
an4.178:3.7: the breaching of the waste-water pool’s embankment would not be expected;
an4.178:3.8: in the same way, the monk enters & remains in a certain peaceful awareness-release.
an4.178:3.9: He attends to the breaching of ignorance,
an4.178:3.10: but as he is attending to the breaching of ignorance his mind doesn’t leap up, grow confident, steadfast, or firm in the breaching of ignorance.
an4.178:3.11: For him the breaching of ignorance is not to be expected.
an4.178:4.1: “Now, there is the case where a monk enters & remains in a certain peaceful awareness-release.
an4.178:4.2: He attends to the breaching of ignorance,
an4.178:4.3: and as he is attending to the breaching of ignorance his mind leaps up, grows confident, steadfast, & firm in the breaching of ignorance.
an4.178:4.4: For him the breaching of ignorance is to be expected.
an4.178:4.5: Just as if there were a waste-water pool that had stood for countless years,
an4.178:4.6: where a man were to open all the inlets and block all the outlets, and the sky were to rain down in good streams of rain:
an4.178:4.7: the breaching of the waste-water pool’s embankment would be expected;
an4.178:4.8: in the same way, the monk enters & remains in a certain peaceful awareness-release.
an4.178:4.9: He attends to the breaching of ignorance,
an4.178:4.10: and as he is attending to the breaching of ignorance his mind leaps up, grows confident, steadfast, & firm in the breaching of ignorance.
an4.178:4.11: For him the breaching of ignorance is to be expected.
an4.178:4.12: “These are four types of individuals to be found existing in the world.”
